verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents role-based access control, fine-grained authorization policies managed centrally, and roles/claims surfaced via OIDC tokens (access tokens, introspection endpoint) for authorization checks, corroborated by community reports of long-term production use for SSO/authorization across services. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of role claims appearing inside JWT token payloads, and independent hands-on verification of token-based role enforcement in a real integration.
